sources.notes: Chart URL is consumed by Excel picture/comment APIs; inspect binary image response instead of coercing it to VBA text.
Also options/chain endpoint; live extractor cases will be attached separately.
Legacy monthly history URL built by smfGetMSNHistory.
Positive data requires an AAPL row with a numeric last price; a generic HTML page or N/A is not working CSV.
Not a stock feed: pTicker is a Netflix movie identifier.60010110 is a legacy ID-shaped reachability input; title identity is not asserted. AAPL is invalid for this endpoint.
Legacy fundamental HTML recipe family. Modern Google Finance homepage/JavaScript redirects do not satisfy the old extraction markers.
Contract symbol AAPL261120C00350000:call350 expiring2026-11-20. Three legacy Yahoo extractor variants will be attached separately.
The actual legacy URL is /data/DGS10; do not replace with a modern FRED API when reporting the SMF result. Input is an economic series, not AAPL.
Still referenced by active custom element20000; the separate MSN option-quote function returns Obsolete before its URLs.
RCHCreateComment choice98 normalizes numeric input1,2,3 to integer plot heights1,50,98. This is a numeric-series chart, not a ticker feed.
Legacy888/OIC full chain; live provider extractors will use2026-11-20call350.
Source itself documents the YQL shutdown. This exact old endpoint must fail its positive-data check if unavailable; do not substitute a new Yahoo API.
Native helper obtains an anonymous cookie/crumb. Several distinct query1 endpoint families are listed in extra_probes.
The shipped recipe literally uses xxxx- before the ticker; preserve it rather than inventing a current company slug.
The financial-data authority is assembled from sAdvFNPrefix, defaultwww. Prefix can be configured by smfSetAdvFNPrefix or smf-AdvFN-Prefix.txt. Also financialgraphs chart endpoint exists.
Market-wide ETF breadth table; AAPL substitution is not applicable.
Market-wide ETF relative-strength table; no ticker parameter in the source recipe.
Also dynamic /term/<metric>/AAPL/<label>/<company-slug> pages and CSV download require separate extraction/provider checks.
Cookie handshake only. HTTP404 may be intentional if Set-Cookie is present; do not call that a quote-data PASS.
Additional configured sAdvFNPrefix=ca case requested by root; defaultwww case remains. This does not change the production setting.
